name: voicenotelog
author: inthedark.org
kirin
short: Log transcriptions of members' voice notes.
description: Port of Seina-Cogs' voicenotelog. Transcribes voice notes with Google's free speech endpoint and posts them to a log channel. Needs ffmpeg on the host. Reads the settings the original cog saved.
install_msg: Unload and uninstall Seina-Cogs' voicenotelog before loading this; its settings carry over. ffmpeg must be installed on the host.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data. Voice notes are sent to Google's speech recognition service to be transcribed.
